headline: President Trump has declared on Truth Social that anyone who says "artificial intelligence" instead of "super intelligence" is an enemy of the White House.
score_reason: Kept at the pool score; the post is confirmed and continues a White House naming campaign, though it changes no policy.
importance_line: It affects federal agencies, which must use the term, and any company or person who might feel pressed to follow, but the president cannot compel private use and "superintelligence" already means AI beyond human ability, so the rename could confuse.
summary: The Independent reports that Trump wrote on Truth Social on Thursday that the White House "considers anyone that uses the term" artificial intelligence, rather than "Super Intelligence", to be "THE ENEMY". It follows an executive order of about a week earlier telling federal agencies to use the new term; our 4 and 5 Oct 2026 editions carried the White House Super Intelligence Force and Elon Musk's plan to rename SpaceXAI as SpaceXSI.
notes: Pool source Forbes returned 403; text read at The Independent, which did its own reporting. Earlier-edition references checked in the 14-day archive.
